### 🔧 Release: v2.0.2 — Post-v2.0.1 Patch Release

Patch release **`v2.0.2`** of **MyHOME for Home Assistant** on **[`OWNd 2.0.2`](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/OWNd/releases/tag/v2.0.2)** (**Home Assistant 2026.8+** / Python 3.14).

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(Staging remaining `v2.0.2` patch pull requests on `chore/release-2.0.2`.)*

#### 📖 Documentation

- **One-Click My Home Assistant Marketplace Repository Badge ([#1024](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1024))**: Added the official My Home Assistant `marketplace_repository` one-click badge (`owner=OpenWebNet-HA`, `repository=MyHOME`, `category=integration`) to `README.md` and `docs/getting-started/installation.md`, guarded by an anti-drift check in `tests/test_ha_standards.py`.

#### ⚙️ CI & Tooling

- **Live Community Verification Traces & Golden Corpus Expansion ([#1021](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1021), [#1022](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1022), [#1023](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1023))**:
  - **`F454` (`FW 2.0.50`) Bus Sweep & Climate/Lighting Capture ([#1021](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1021))**: Archived a 240-frame (`186 rx`, `54 tx`) physical `F454` `FW 2.0.50` sweep covering `WHO = 1, 2, 4, 13, 1013` (`tests/fixtures/traces/f454_2_0_50_sweep_2026-11-26/`) with provenance, privacy, and end-to-end Home Assistant replay tests.
  - **`F459` (`FW 2.1.5`) Full Debug Log & `14` Golden Corpus Fixtures ([#1022](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1022))**: Archived a sanitized `2,943`-line `F459` `FW 2.1.5` full debug log (`tests/fixtures/traces/f459_full_debug_log_2026-11-26/`) expanding trace-matrix coverage for `WHO = 25` & `WHO = 1001`, and staged `14` schema- and builder-verified `community-plant-capture` fixtures (`467 → 481` corpus records, `295 → 309` golden shapes) in `tests/golden/`.
  - **`F454` 4-Zone Central Unit (`#0#1`) `v2.0.1` Verification Trace ([#994](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/issues/994), [#1023](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/1023))**: Added an 18-frame live `F454` `FW 2.0.51` + `4695` 4-zone central unit verification trace (`tests/fixtures/traces/issue_994/`) and end-to-end replay test confirming central-unit setpoint propagation and direct subordinate zone writes on `v2.0.1` / `OWNd 2.0.2`.
